name: CensusHouseholds
description: Census returns and population registers that list the members of each household with age, sex and occupation.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no census household entries. Otherwise, set to false.

household.description: The household number or identifier as written. Use null if not stated.

person.description: The full name of the person, as written.

age.description: The age in years. Use null if not stated or illegible.

sex.description: The sex of the person as recorded. Use null if not stated.

occupation.description: The occupation as written. Use null if not stated.

relation_to_head.description: The relation to the head of household as written. Example: 'wife', 'son' or 'servant'. Use null if not stated.

address.description: The street, house or parcel of the household as written. Use null if not stated.

source_page.description: The page or folio on which the entry appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the entry, such as marital status or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
